::: {.minipage data-latex="{\textwidth}"}
### `SelectHighlightedWordReport`

Selects a highlighted text window in the **Word Breakdown** section.
(Can also optionally find and select a string in it.)

#### Syntax {-}

``` {.lua}
SelectHighlightedWordReport(HighlightedReportType windowToSelect,
                            string contentToHighlight)
```

#### Parameters {-}

**Parameter** | **Description**
| :-- | :-- |
| [`HighlightedReportType`](#highlightedreporttype) windowToSelect | The text window to select. | 
| `string` contentToHighlight | An optional string to search for and highlight in the text window. |
:::
